program.merge_policy: accumulate eight 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after 200

policy.validation_strategy: cheap duplicate/entity/source screening during authoring; expensive repository-wide validation only after Wave 500

waves.focus: Salvia officinalis extract in 60 euglycemic women with PCOS for 8 weeks; HOMA-IR/insulin/QUICKI/BMI signals with WHR/SBP nulls; PCOS/formulation specific.
Standardized Zembrin safety/tolerability study in 37 healthy adults over 3 months; no efficacy variables, so safety-only evidence.
Proprietary Zembrin crossover study in 21 healthy adults over 3 weeks; selected cognitive/executive signals with small-sample/product boundary.
Single-dose Zembrin study in 20 healthy volunteers; one anxiety experiment null with selected subjective/heart-rate interaction signals; acute small-sample evidence.
12-week DB-RCT in overweight/obesity; DXA total-fat-mass signal but body-fat-percent coprimary null; retrospective registration and preliminary status preserved.
Exact-species older trial in prediabetes/hyperlipidemia using leaf/root-bark preparation; species/preparation firewall retained.
Exact-species T2D crossover study using extract biscuit; food-matrix/formulation and diabetes-population boundary retained.
Kothala Himbutu tea trial in T2D; exact-species beverage preparation retained separately from extracts.
Open-label obesity evidence for Salacia plus vitamin D3; combination-only and nonblinded, so no single-ingredient attribution.
Patented multi-ingredient menopausal VMS product RCT; hot-flash/HFRDIS signals, MENQOL/PSQI nulls, product-level only with sponsor/conflict provenance.
Source-integrity correction: PMID 20386132 is a citrulline-malate trial, not taurine; preserve as an anti-contamination receipt.
Retracted aged-garlic meta-analysis; retain only as quarantine metadata and never aggregate into active efficacy evidence.
Curcumin-piperine evidence is formulation-specific; piperine-containing products must not be generalized to curcumin alone.
T2D nanocurcumin evidence; nanoformulation and diabetes population remain explicit and non-interchangeable with generic curcumin.
Herbal network meta-analysis in MASLD/MASH focused on liver enzymes/stiffness; multi-intervention disease-specific evidence only.
72 RCTs/6,351 participants in sepsis; injectable route is fundamental and must not be inherited by oral botanical products.
Eleven-botanical adjunctive HFrEF formulation; product/composition and adjunct-to-standard-care boundaries retained.
Formula evidence in neuropathy-prevention context; multi-herb formulation and indication-specific boundary retained.
Scoping review of 47 studies/2,568 participants; traditional multi-herb formula evidence remains product/formula specific.
Review of 96 formula RCTs documenting harms-reporting deficiencies; evidence-quality/safety infrastructure, not proof of safety.
26-RCT active-control AE meta-analysis with lower reported AE risk; comparator/formulation-specific and not proof of intrinsic herbal safety.
Herbal-interaction evidence in radiation oncology; treatment-context safety layer only.
Emerging supplement/cosmetic allergen evidence; safety/identity layer only, with exposure route and product composition preserved.
12-week skin-aging RCT using Agastache alone versus Agastache/Ficus/Lycium combination; industry provenance and arm identity retained.
Khapregesic-specific menopausal-symptom RCT; preparation-specific product evidence with no generic Khaya inheritance.
